metrics.label: Completed hikes
metrics.whatCounts: Each hike saved with completed status counts once. Active, cancelled and abandoned sessions do not count.

metrics.label: Recorded hiking distance
metrics.whatCounts: Adds the recorded distance in completed hike summaries, rather than the trail’s planned length. Missing distance contributes zero. Each session is counted once.
metrics.goal: Accumulate {target} km of recorded distance across completed hikes.

metrics.label: Recorded hiking time
metrics.whatCounts: Adds completed hike duration rounded down to whole minutes. This includes recorded rest time; it is not moving time. Each session is counted once.

metrics.label: Different trails completed
metrics.whatCounts: Complete a recorded trail. Each trail ID counts once, even when the same trail is hiked again. Unlisted hikes without a recorded trail ID do not add a different trail.

metrics.label: Malaysian states hiked
metrics.whatCounts: Complete a recorded trail located in one of Malaysia’s 13 states. A state counts once. Federal territories and repeated hikes within a counted state do not add another state.
metrics.goal: Complete hikes in {target} different Malaysian states.

metrics.label: Completed team hikes
metrics.whatCounts: The team session must finish with every participant’s hike completed and no recorded separation alert. Ending your own hike while the team is still active does not yet count.

metrics.label: Public stories published
metrics.whatCounts: Publish a public community story. Drafts and private posts do not count. Each published post ID counts once.

metrics.label: Verified hazard reports
metrics.whatCounts: A hazard report you submitted must reach verified status. Unverified, rejected and resolved-only reports do not count. Each report counts once.

metrics.label: Security methods configured
metrics.whatCounts: Successfully configure Authenticator or a passkey. Each method type counts once. Removing a method does not revoke an already earned badge.

defaults.rewardRecognition: Earn this badge once and add its points to your Trail Journey level.
